Film 'Hanu-man Ansh' Tops Box Office, Outperforms New Releases

The film 'Hanu-man Ansh' continues to lead the box office several days after its release, with 'Mirzapur The Movie' ranking second. Meanwhile, Kunal Kemmu's film 'Vibe' and Kareena Kapoor's film 'Daayra' are reportedly not drawing audiences to cinemas. 'Hanu-man Ansh' saw increased earnings on Tuesday, a day associated with Hanuman.
